prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG low-resolution pixel-art PROP REVIEW BOARD, uniform opaque neutral grey background, three separate props in a single row with ample spacing, no text, labels, numbers, arrows or UI. Chunky square pixels, dark selective outlines, muted brown wood and dull iron, three-tone shading. LEFT: short fragment of old dock plank with a single empty iron berth ring/nail, no boat or tying rope attached. MIDDLE: a short detached rope with a loosened old knot and separate free ends resting flat, a withdrawal knot study not a freshly bound pledge. RIGHT: one worn old narrow wooden seat/name plank, plain scratched surface with NO readable inscription, preserved family remembrance separate from occupied berth. These are three independent source object studies, not an outcome sequence. No body, ghost, memorial tomb, money, signed lease, missing person's fate, ownership claim, full pier or new boat. Need legible silhouettes of unused berth nail, withdrawal rope knot and retained old seat-board. Not native sprites or final UI.
